description:
Cast Queen Allenal of Ruadach by paying its mana cost.
When Queen Allenal of Ruadach enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Queen Allenal of Ruadach with haste plus at least one additional token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Honor-Worn Shaku to tap one of the Queen Allenal of Ruadach tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Holding priority, use the ability of Honor-Worn Shaku to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
